text: Adaeze's grandad passed away on Sunday. Funeral is Thursday 29 October at 11am at St Mary's. She sounded exhausted.
siddharth got his redundancy letter today, last day 30 nov. gutted, he'd been there 9 yrs
Pieter and his wife have a new puppy, a beagle called Biscuit. Already chewed through a phone charger apparently.
Note to self, Sinead's band is playing the Grapes on Friday at 8pm. Bring earplugs this time.

Nasser said his cat Tilly's been off her food all week, vet tomorrow morning at 9. He's really worried about her. She's 16 now and he's had her since before he met his wife Esther, so she's basically family. He said if it's bad news he doesn't know what he'll do. He's working from home tomorrow so he can sit with her afterwards.
Text Leah good luck before the half marathon on Sunday 1 November 2026, she's been training since June.
ines and jorge split up. she's staying at her sister's for now. don't bring him up

Adriana's recital is the 14th at half 7, Chopin and some Debussy. She's terrified, hasn't played in public since uni and her teacher keeps adding pieces. Her parents are driving down from Leeds for it, which apparently makes it worse. She said she'd rather I didn't come to this one, fair enough. Must send her a message that afternoon, something short, no pressure.
krisztina's dog rolo turns 5 next week lol they're doing a doggy cake
Ali reckons Liverpool tickets came through for the 22nd at 3pm. He's taking his son, first match for the little one.
Wei's dad died in August. She mentioned the headstone goes in on 12 December 2026, they're all going back to Penang for it.

Ximena's play opens Thursday 5 November, runs till the Saturday. She's playing the landlady. Book tickets for Friday night!! Ask Wei and Ravi if they want to come too, Ming's busy that week. Ximena said the Saturday matinee is nearly sold out already, and the Thursday is mostly friends and family of the cast. Last time I left it too late.

Uh so Lwazi, he was saying the redundancy consultations start Monday at 10, he's in the first group. He's trying to stay positive but you can tell it's getting to him. Ask him how it went Monday evening.
Moira's lost her dog. Collie, Bess, got out through the back gate yesterday afternoon. Share the post on the village group.
Ravi has a new kitten! Ginger, named Mango. His girlfriend Ming picked the name.
ming's mum is having her hip op on the 3rd, ming is staying with her that week
Laura's funeral planning for her nan, they want it the week of 9 November 2026. She asked if I could do a reading. I said yes.
Esther's choir competition in Cardiff, Saturday 7 November. They got through the regional round in September.
jamal moved to the Bristol office, starts there after half term. wants to get back into five a side, ask if he wants to join ours
Thomas mentioned Afua's been really down since the breakup. He thinks she'd like it if I checked in. Ring her this weekend, maybe Saturday morning.
Afua: mad into bouldering now, goes three nights a week. Hates running. Vegan since January.
Jorge's dog had to be put to sleep this morning. Fourteen years. He said he's fine but he really didn't sound it.
mateo racing at Brands Hatch 15 nov 2026, karting championship final. he's top 3 going in
Rosa's cat is having surgery Tuesday at 2pm, lump on his side. Pick up some cat treats for when he's home.
Colm's hen do got cancelled, well, stag do, he and Oisín called off the wedding. Not sure what happened. Leave it a week then message him.
Mihai - plays cello in an amateur orchestra, works at the hospital pharmacy, lives in Didsbury with partner Hemi. Hemi does pottery.
Hemi's pottery exhibition is the 20th at 6pm, small gallery on Oldham St. Mihai said she's nervous about selling anything.
Noah failed his grade 5 piano by two marks. Retake in March 2027. He's annoyed more than upset.
Need to get Elijah something for his birthday, 2 December. He keeps going on about a new climbing chalk bag.

Oisín's grandmother died last night, he's flying to Galway tomorrow at 6am. Funeral probably Monday. He was really close to her, she basically raised him for a few years when his mum was ill. Should send flowers to the family, ask Colm for the address, he'll know it. Also check if Oisín needs someone to mind his cat while he's away.
vet for Pepper Thursday 4.15, boosters. Also flea stuff.
Pick up dry cleaning before Saturday, need the black suit for the funeral.
Ordered a new lead and harness, should come Wednesday. Puppy classes start 9 January 2027 at 10am.
Gig tickets for the 18th went on sale at 9, missed them. Try the resale site tonight.
Got my race number for the 10k on 8 November. Bus at 7.30am from town.
Nothing much. Long day.
Adaeze says thank you for the card. She's going back to work on the 2nd, half days at first. Check in with her that week, maybe lunch Wednesday.
Dr Fischer, Nasser's vet, said Tilly has kidney disease. Special diet now and a check-up in 6 weeks. Nasser took it pretty hard.
Siddharth has an interview at Rolls-Royce on Monday at 2pm! First one since the redundancy. Don't forget to text him that morning.
pieter - biscuit graduated puppy school haha. they did a little cap
Sinead's sister Leah Johnson is the one who did the Edinburgh marathon, not Sinead. Keep them straight!
Spoke to Ines this morning. Moving out of the flat they shared on the 31st at 10am, Thomas is lending his van. She's okay, mostly just tired of it all.
krisztina's grandad's 90th is sat 21 nov, big family do. she wants ideas for a gift, he likes birds and crosswords
Ali's brother Noah got made redundant too, same week as the Liverpool match. Their dad's furious on his behalf.
Wei mentioned her niece's ballet show, Sunday at 2. Wei's going with her mum.

Okay so recap from drinks. Ximena is fine after opening night, said the reviews were mixed but the cast loved it. Her partner Mateo was there with his parents, who flew in from Valencia. They're staying until 15 November. Ximena wants to take them to the coast that weekend. Also she's thinking of auditioning for the panto, auditions 1 December 2026 at 6pm. I should send her the link to the casting page.
Lwazi's rescue greyhound Duke arrived Saturday. Very shy, sleeps 20 hours a day. He's buying him a coat for winter, I said I'd look for a second hand one.
Moira - Bess found!! Neighbour two streets over had her in the shed. Ask her how Bess is doing tomorrow.
ravi n ming anniversary 12 dec, going to Lisbon for it. ravi asked me to feed mango that weekend
Laura's reading at the funeral went well apparently, her Uncle Mihai cried. Must send her a text later tonight to see how she's holding up.
Esther's choir won! First place in Cardiff. Send congrats and ask when the national round is, I think March 2027.
Jamal's mum Mrs Ahmed passed away last week. Funeral was Friday, I couldn't go. Should call him this week, maybe Thursday evening after 7.
Thomas Williams - 'Tommo' - from the running club. Works in IT at the council, two kids, wife's called Rosa. Doing the Manchester marathon April 2027.
Rosa says her cat Marmite's surgery went fine, lump was benign. Stitches out on the 10th at 11.

Colm seemed better. Back at the climbing wall Tuesdays, new flat in Ancoats from 1 December, says the breakup's the best thing that happened. Hard to tell if he means it. He's also signed up for a bouldering comp on 16 January 2027, his first one. And he asked after Oisín, which I didn't expect. Said he still wants to give him the record player back but doesn't know how to bring it up.
Mihai's orchestra concert Saturday 28 November at 7.30pm, Elgar cello concerto, he's got the solo. He's been practising every night and says he can't sleep. Remind me to wish him luck the day before.

Noah's parrot, Captain, is apparently 31 years old. Older than Noah. It was his late grandad's and came to him when his grandad died in 2019. They're having a little party for Captain on Sunday at 4, with his mum and his sister Rosa. Captain only says 'hello darling' and swears at the postman.
Elijah's girlfriend Adriana got the job at the conservatoire, starts January 2027. They might move to Glasgow by spring.

Long call with Oisín. He's back from Galway, the funeral was lovely, whole village came out. His mum is struggling though, she's on her own in the house now and he's thinking of going back over for Christmas, maybe 20 December to 2 January. He also said his boss has been decent about the time off. I need to drop round with some food this week, Wednesday or Thursday evening probably.
Cancelled the dentist on Friday at 3pm, need to rebook for sometime in November.
